action.command: cd /workspace && for c in gateway:7003 manager:3002 notification:3003 task:3000; do svc=${c%%:*}; port=${c##*:}; out=$(docker compose exec -T $svc sh -c "node -e \"const http=require('http');http.get('http://localhost:$port/test/ping',r=>{console.log(r.statusCode);process.exit(0)}).on('error',e=>{console.log('ERR:'+e.code);process.exit(0)})\"" 2>/dev/null); echo "$svc ($port): $out"; done
